pretreatments.description: Peracetic acid (PAA) pretreatment at concentrations of 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 mM/g VS.  PAA was added by stirring the sludge with a magnetic stirrer at 450 rpm for 30 min at 25 °C.

PAA pretreatment at concentrations of 2, 3 and 4 mM/g VS.  PAA was added by stirring the sludge with a magnetic stirrer at 450 rpm for 30 min at 25 °C.
